title: Brex pricing - Free Essentials tier, $12/user/month Premium, custom Enterprise
clean_text: Brex's Essentials plan is free and usable by small businesses and startups. The Premium plan, aimed at midsize growth-stage companies, costs $12 per user per month. Enterprise pricing is custom, negotiated with Brex's sales team based on employee count, selected modules, and contract length. For a mid-sized company with 100-250 employees on a 12-month contract, typical total annual cost falls between $15,000 and $60,000 depending on tier and modules.
